projects.title: Kalleh Halloumi Cheese ,AdverGame
projects.description: A virtual reality marketing game developed for Kalleh Foods to promote their Halloumi Cheese product through an interactive cooking experience. Players enter a fully immersive VR kitchen where they prepare and cook Halloumi Cheese using realistic interactions, including grabbing, cutting, grilling, and serving ingredients.The project focused on delivering intuitive VR gameplay, realistic object interactions, and an engaging user experience that highlights the products features in a memorable way. I was responsible for implementing the gameplay systems, VR interactions, object physics, user interface integration, and overall technical development of the experience.

projects.title: Snake Quizz Ladder
projects.description: My independently developed multiplayer board game brings quiz challenges to snakes and ladders. Roll the dice, climb the board and test your knowledge, with category-based trophies that give every answer a sense of progression. Recent development adds clubs, friend requests and real-time chat, alongside a remotely configured cosmetics shop and player customization. Built with Unity and a Node.js backend, the game combines server-authoritative dice outcomes with physics-driven dice animation. Now approaching a playable demo.
